classified_object.notes: Track and field competition under World Para Athletics classification and rules.

performance_agency.summary: Athlete performance remains decisive within sport class.

performance_interface.summary: Includes prostheses, racing chairs, throwing frames, guides; adaptive interfaces preserve athletic agency.

embodied_performance.summary: Includes prostheses, racing chairs, throwing frames, guides; adaptive interfaces preserve athletic agency. Migrated as Embodied Performance; demand types are provisional.

arena.summary: Physical track/field with class-specific equipment constraints.

distributed_arena_relation.synchronization_mechanism: Timing, measurement, and officiating systems coordinate event state.
distributed_arena_relation.calibration_equivalence: Classification, equipment, and measurement controls support comparison.
distributed_arena_relation.officiation_relation: Officials and classification governance apply to the event.
distributed_arena_relation.safety_relation: Venue and event safety responsibility is defined.

sensing_tracking.summary: Standard athletics measurement plus classification evaluation processes.

measurement.summary: Times, distances, and placings within class.

comparability.summary: Explicitly class-relative comparability; not a defect.

outcome_openness.summary: Outcomes depend on performance within class constraints.

consequence_structure.summary: Championship results and physical performance costs.

operational_spatial_integration.summary: Classification is integrity/comparability infrastructure, not computational arena unification.

source_provisional_finding.summary: Preserves sport under body variation; rejects single normative body assumption.

content: Hybrid para events whose decisive constraints are computationally constituted shared arenas, evaluated separately from classification.

evidence_sources.publisher: International Paralympic Committee / World Para Athletics

record.provenance_note: Per-field claim_class and status preserved verbatim from the source case. source_provisional_finding is the corpus's own attributed reading, not a new Atlas verdict. Provider claims live in evidence_sources; Altis interpretation carries C4/C5.
